8187-the-complete-poems-of-sir-thomas-mo.creator: Unknown
8187-the-complete-poems-of-sir-thomas-mo.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. soon launched upon a current of ideas and associations which might have conducted a person of more self-oblivious patriotism to the scaffold on which perished the friend of his opening manhood, Robert Emmet. Trinity College, Dublin, having been opened to Catholics by the Irish Parliament in 1793, Moore was entered there as a student in the succeeding year. He became more proficient in French and Italian than in the classic languages, and showed no turn for Latin verses.

arxiv-2111-00833.title: Swift sky localization of gravitational waves using deep learning seeded importance sampling
arxiv-2111-00833.creator: Alex Kolmus, Grégory Baltus, Justin Janquart, Twan van Laarhoven, Sarah Caudill, Tom Heskes
arxiv-2111-00833.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alex Kolmus, Grégory Baltus, Justin Janquart, Twan van Laarhoven, Sarah Caudill, Tom Heskes. Fast, highly accurate, and reliable inference of the sky origin of gravitational waves would enable real-time multi-messenger astronomy. Current Bayesian inference methodologies, although highly accurate and reliable, are slow. Deep learning models have shown themselves to be accurate and extremely fast for inference tasks on gravitational waves, but their output is inherently questionable due to the blackbox nature of neural networks.

arxiv-2205-06619.title: FastSTMF : Efficient tropical matrix factorization algorithm for sparse data
arxiv-2205-06619.creator: Amra Omanović, Polona Oblak, Tomaž Curk
arxiv-2205-06619.description: Abstract Matrix factorization, one of the most popular methods in machine learning, has recently benefited from introducing non-linearity in prediction tasks using tropical semiring. The non-linearity enables a better fit to extreme values and distributions, thus discovering high-variance patterns that differ from those found by standard linear algebra. However, the optimization process of various tropical matrix factorization methods is slow.

arxiv-2311-08141.title: GMTR: Graph Matching Transformers
arxiv-2311-08141.creator: Jinpei Guo, Shaofeng Zhang, Runzhong Wang, Chang Liu, Junchi Yan
arxiv-2311-08141.description: Abstract Vision transformers (ViTs) have recently been used for visual matching. The original grid dividing strategy of ViTs neglects the spatial information of the keypoints, limiting the sensitivity to local information. We propose QueryTrans (Query Transformer), which adopts a cross-attention module and keypoints-based center crop strategy for better spatial information extraction.

arxiv-2312-04388.title: Cosmological domain walls from the breaking of 𝐒 𝟒 \mathbf{S_{4}} flavor symmetry
arxiv-2312-04388.creator: Adil Jueid, Mohamed Amin Loualidi, Salah Nasri, Mohamed Amine Ouahid
arxiv-2312-04388.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Adil Jueid, Mohamed Amin Loualidi, Salah Nasri, Mohamed Amine Ouahid. In this work, we delve into the often-overlooked cosmological implications of spontaneous breaking of non-Abelian discrete groups, specifically focusing on the formation of domain walls in the case of S 4 S_{4} flavor symmetry. In particular, we investigate three interesting breaking patterns of the S 4 S_{4} group and study the structure of the domain walls in the broken phase for three possible residual symmetries.

arxiv-2404-01499.title: Effective Categorical Enumerative Invariants
arxiv-2404-01499.creator: Andrei Căldăraru Junwu Tu
arxiv-2404-01499.description: Abstract We introduce enumerative invariants F g , n F_{g,n} ( g ≥ 0 CLOSE (g\geq 0 , OPEN n ≥ 1 ) n\geq 1) associated to a cyclic A ∞ A_{\infty} algebra and a splitting of its non-commutative Hodge filtration.

arxiv-2503-01754.title: SDRT: Enhance Vision-Language Models by Self-Distillation with Diverse Reasoning Traces
arxiv-2503-01754.creator: Guande Wu, Huan Song, Yawei Wang, Qiaojing Yan, Yijun Tian, Lin Lee Cheong, Panpan Xu
arxiv-2503-01754.description: Abstract Reasoning is increasingly crucial for various tasks. While chain-of-thought prompting enables large language models to leverage reasoning effectively, harnessing the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remains challenging. To solve this problem, we propose a novel self-distillation framework that enhances the reasoning capabilities of the model. The proposed framework introduces several key innovations.

arxiv-2507-16268.title: Ionisation potentials and energy levels of ions of heavy and superheavy elements Te, I, Po, At, Lv and Ts.
arxiv-2507-16268.creator: G. K. Vong, V. A. Dzuba, V. V. Flambaum
arxiv-2507-16268.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by G. K. Vong, V. A. Dzuba, V. V. Flambaum. We calculate the energy levels and successive ionisation potentials (IPs) of ions of the three heaviest known Group 16 and 17 elements using a theoretical approach that combines the linearised coupled-cluster method, configuration interaction, and perturbation theory. Our calculations address critical gaps in the available data on the electronic structure of the superheavy elements livermorium (Lv) and tennessine (Ts), as well as their lighter homologues polonium (Po) and astatine (At).

arxiv-2509-24292.title: Strongly Hopfian and Co-Hopfian Acts over Monoids: Structure and Characterizations
arxiv-2509-24292.creator: Ali Madanshekaf, Farideh Farsad
arxiv-2509-24292.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ali Madanshekaf, Farideh Farsad. In this paper, we introduce and explore new classes of S S -acts over a monoid S S , namely, strongly Hopfian and strongly co-Hopfian acts, as well as their weaker counterparts, Hopfian and co-Hopfian acts. We investigate the relationships between these newly defined structures and well-studied classes of S S -acts, including Noetherian, Artinian, injective, projective, quasi-injective, and quasi-projective acts.

arxiv-2510-25086.title: Mean-Shift Theory and Its Applications in Swarm Robotics A New Way to Enhance the Efficiency of Multi-Robot Collaboration
arxiv-2510-25086.creator: Guibin Sun, Jinhu Lü, Fellow, IEEE , Kexin Liu, Zhenqian Wang, and Guanrong Chen, Life Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2510-25086.description: Abstract S warms evolving from collective behaviors among multiple individuals are commonly seen in nature, which enables biological systems to exhibit more efficient and robust collaboration. Creating similar swarm intelligence in engineered robots poses challenges to the design of collaborative algorithms that can be programmed at large scales.

pmc-10675700.title: Instance Segmentation and Ensemble Learning for Automatic Temperature Detection in Multiparous Sows
pmc-10675700.creator: Hongxiang Xue, Mingxia Shen, Yuwen Sun, Haonan Tian, Zihao Liu, Jinxin Chen, Peiquan Xu, Wonsuk (Daniel) Lee
pmc-10675700.description: The core body temperature serves as a pivotal physiological metric indicative of sow health, with rectal thermometry prevailing as a prevalent method for estimating core body temperature within sow farms. Nonetheless, employing contact thermometers for rectal temperature measurement proves to be time-intensive, labor-demanding, and hygienically suboptimal.

pmc-11313441.creator: Jacek J. Sznurkowski, Lubomir Bodnar, Łukasz Szylberg, Agnieszka Zołciak-Siwinska, Anna Dańska-Bidzińska, Dagmara Klasa-Mazurkiewicz, Agnieszka Rychlik, Artur Kowalik, Joanna Streb, Mariusz Bidziński, Włodzimierz Sawicki
pmc-11313441.description: Background: Recent publications underscore the need for updated recommendations addressing less radical surgery for <2 cm tumors, induction chemotherapy, or immunotherapy for locally advanced stages of cervical cancer, as well as for the systemic therapy for recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer.

pmc-11473482.title: Highly efficient synthesis of the chiral ACE inhibitor intermediate (R)-2-hydroxy-4-phenylbutyrate ethyl ester via engineered bi-enzyme coupled systems
pmc-11473482.creator: Yanmei Dai, Jinmei Wang, Zijuan Tao, Liangli Luo, Changshun Huang, Bo Liu, Hanbing Shi, Lan Tang, Zhimin Ou
pmc-11473482.description: (R)-2-Hydroxy-4-phenylbutyric acid ethyl ester ((R)-HPBE) is an essential chiral intermediate in the synthesis of angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. Its production involves the highly selective asymmetric reduction of ethyl 2-oxo-4-phenylbutyrate (OPBE), catalyzed by carbonyl reductase (CpCR), with efficient cofactor regeneration playing a crucial role.

pmc-11579450.title: Suitability of rocks, minerals, and cement waste for CO2 removal via enhanced rock weathering
pmc-11579450.creator: Megan Danczyk, Christopher Oze
pmc-11579450.description: Mineral and rock additions to the environment have been proposed as a pathway to remove atmospheric CO2. This process occurs when hydrated minerals or rocks increase alkalinity, promoting the formation of bicarbonate. In this study, we evaluate the potential of commonly used hydrated rock and mineral powders to enhance alkalinity and react with both atmospheric and concentrated CO2.

pmc-12405145.title: Patients’ willingness to pay for health care quality improvement under universal healthcare coverage in Egypt
pmc-12405145.creator: Hebatullah H. Rozza, Taghareed A. Elhoseny, Safaa H. Abbas, Rasha A. Mosallam
pmc-12405145.description: BackgroundIn economics, the word “willingness to pay” refers to the highest amount that an individual would be willing to pay, give up, or exchange to obtain goods or services or to avoid something undesirable. It can be applied in healthcare as a way to evaluate the worth of improving the quality of health services.

pmc-12452853.title: Immune-mediated bone loss: A Mendelian randomization and NHANES-based study of viral infections and osteoporosis
pmc-12452853.creator: Li Xiong, Lingting Wang, He Liu, Yufei He, Hong Wang, Fan Bai
pmc-12452853.description: Highlights•This study is the first to reveal potential causal relationships between antibody levels of Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV), Human Herpesvirus 6 (HHV-6), and Varicella-Zoster Virus (VZV) and osteoporosis from a genetic perspective.•Highlights the differential impact of viral infections on bone mineral density across specific populations, such as young men and elderly women, offering new directions for personalized prevention strategies.

pmc-12814583.title: Exploration of novel therapeutic targets for keloids based on clinical and molecular data: the role of the IL-4/IL-13 signaling pathway
pmc-12814583.creator: Xueli Li, Jianping Lan, Ruoyun Liu, Tingting Lin, Zheqi Li, Bo Cheng
pmc-12814583.description: Background and ObjectivesKeloids are problematic fibrotic lesions with excessive collagen and chronic inflammation; their underlying causes are not fully understood. Type 2 helper T (Th2) cytokines IL-4 and IL-13 are implicated in various fibrotic disorders, including but not limited to pulmonary fibrosis and systemic sclerosis.
